languageDesc: Choose the plugin UI language. 'Auto' follows SiYuan system setting.
languageChanged: Language changed. Please restart SiYuan to fully apply.
hugoRepoPathDesc: Absolute path to the root of your local Hugo repository.
contentBaseDirDesc: Relative content directory inside the Hugo repository, for example content/post.
defaultCategoryDesc: Optionally written into categories on export. A pre-export confirmation dialog is also available. Default is empty.
confirmCategoryBeforeExportDesc: Show a dialog to review or edit the detected category before each export.
confirmCategoryDesc: Detected category: ${category}. You may edit it below.
customCategoryHint: Separate multiple categories with English commas
commitMessageTemplateDesc: Supports {title} and {docId}. Used when git commit runs.
defaultDraftDesc: If enabled, exported posts are marked as draft unless custom-hugo-draft overrides it.
autoPushAfterExportDesc: If enabled, a normal export will also run git add, commit and push.
stripDefaultImageAltTextDesc: On export, clear the default image alt text 'image' so Hugo themes do not show it as a caption. Manually written alt text is preserved.
desktopOnly: This plugin currently works in SiYuan desktop only.
repoPathRequired: Please configure the Hugo repository path first.
notGitRepo: The configured Hugo path is not a git repository: ${path}
outsideRepoWrite: Refusing to write outside the Hugo repository: ${path}
assetsSkipped: The following assets were not exported, please handle them manually
settingsUnavailable: Unable to open the settings panel.
